verdict_table.claim: A1 every row's T and T / T_slaved3 (exact-integer brackets, own stencil, own slaved bound)
verdict_table.own: 20 rows reproduced to 1.4e-10 relative; ratios 0.98747 to 1.00921; director row and M_0i exactly 0, M_33 - 1 = 6e-5 to 2.1e-3 delta, M_00 - 8 = 1e-7 to 4e-6 delta, z variation 3e-5 to 8e-4 delta, pair mean 3e-5 to 9e-4 delta

verdict_table.claim: A2 the delta 0.003 and 0.001 rows reached the gate; extrapolations 1.006 +- 0.008 and 1.011 +- 0.0001
verdict_table.own: the converged delta 0.01 fields rescaled to delta 0.001 (pair x r, slot deviations x r^2, shell exact) give T / T_slaved3 = [0.98747, 0.99456, 0.99709, 0.99938] at h 1.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5, below every audited delta 0.001 row ([0.99465, 1.00368, 1.00689, 1.00921]); own deviation-native descents from the audited rows fall to [0.99452, 0.99448, 0.9873] (n48 d0.001, n48 d0.003, n32 d0.001) in at most 1500 iterations; the rows stopped at 19 to 40 iterations on ftol / line search because M_00 near 8 is quantized at 1.8e-15 in float64 (0.7 to 1.5 percent of energy left); the h^2 extrapolation of the converged twins is 1.0006

verdict_table.claim: A3 the delta 0.03 and 0.01 rows at h <= 1 FALLING at 0.9945 to 0.9995
verdict_table.own: ratios reproduced; own 1500-iteration continuation of d0.03 h1 moves 0.99456 to 0.99453 with the per-250-iteration drop falling 5e-6 to 1e-6 (converged to 1e-5); the ratios track the BPS seed's own lattice factor [0.9858, 0.9936, 0.9964, 0.9984]: divided out [1.0017, 1.0009, 1.0007, 1.0011]; h^2 extrapolation 1.0007 (delta 0.01), 1.0002 (delta 0.03)

verdict_table.claim: B plain V4 round-off 1e-7 at delta 0.001, telescoped under 1e-8
verdict_table.own: on the n48 BPS seed the plain form is off by -2.4e-08 at delta 0.001 (6.5e-09 at 0.003, 1.7e-10 at 0.01), 4e-8 to 6.6e-8 on the stored delta 0.001 rows; the own telescoped form about diag(-8, s0, s0, 1) is exact to 1e-15 at every delta; telescoped about the literal diag(-8, 1, delta, 0) still 1.1e-11; the p = 4 bracket in plain form is pure noise at delta 0.001 (error 9.4e-13 against a true 8.6e-13)
verdict_table.verdict: CONFIRMED (plain floor 2e-8 to 7e-8, same order; the digit loss that stops the small-delta rows is the FIELD's float64 quantization of M_00, not the energy form)

verdict_table.claim: C exponent of T against delta on the AT_GATE h 1.5 rows = 3.994
verdict_table.own: own exact T on the same three rows: 3.9938; on all four h 1.5 rows 3.9912; T_slaved3's own exponent over 0.03 to 0.001: 3.9938 (the departure from 4 is the slaved bound's K_eff drift, not the lattice)

verdict_table.claim: D1 artifact energies 0.235, 0.574, 0.131 T_bps; x2 interpolation raises them to 2.1 to 22.7; strands keep 0.840 to 0.842; pure winding 11.6 to 115 T_bps growing as 1/h^2
D2 the low energies are LATTICE artifacts (they do not survive refinement); the texture: the line angle drifts and jumps between neighboring cells
verdict_table.own: texture (z = 0): b / b0 stays 0.77 to 0.98 in the core (no melted core), the winding sits on one plaquette, 7 to 107 bonds carry angle jumps over 150 degrees (pi-walls of the pair anisotropy) and 15 to 233 over 90 degrees, only 2.5 to 5 percent of E_u within 3 h (spread), the central / one-sided energy ratio 1.05 to 14.3 against 0.99 on the smooth strands (a one-bond-wide structure). Across a pi-wall M jumps by 2 b R but F = [A_x, A_y]_eta vanishes where the field is constant along the wall and V4 is blind to it (same eigenvalues): the commutator-only functional is degenerate for 1D and point structures in the CONTINUUM too (the pure winding with an unmelted point core has u = 32 (b b' / rho)^2 = 0). Decisive: re-relaxing the x2-refined escape field for 400 iterations at h 0.5 takes it from 8.88 back to 0.259 T_bps (0.326 after 100), below the smooth strand's 0.84 and still falling, so the state re-forms on the finer grid
verdict_table.audited: lattice artifact by the x2 interpolation test
verdict_table.verdict: QUALIFIED (the interpolation-without-relaxation test does not show the state disappears with h; it re-forms at h/2; the degeneracy is the functional's, exploited at the cell scale)

verdict_table.claim: E1 the stored strands' director-row residue is sub-1e-6 and is what gets amplified
verdict_table.own: director row of the stored R25-1 fields: 4.3e-4 delta (d0.03), 2.6e-3 delta (d0.3), 2.5e-4 delta (d0.01); the director-row gradient 2.3e-9 (d0.03) and 6.1e-7 (d0.3) absolute
verdict_table.verdict: REFUTED as a number (the residue is 1e-4 to 1e-3 of delta; a seed for amplification exists either way)

verdict_table.claim: E2 the block strand is a saddle of the lattice energy; does the unstable direction survive refinement
verdict_table.own: d0.03 h1: lowest Hessian eigenvalue in the director-row subspace -1.02e-05 (converged; largest 1.95e-03): a saddle; in the block subspace (Jacobi-scaled, same inertia) -2.57e-03 with a cell-scale mode (roughness 1.92 of 2.83): a saddle inside the block sector too. The h 1 director mode carried to h 0.5 keeps a NEGATIVE Rayleigh quotient -1.56e-06 (a rigorous upper bound on lambda_min at h 0.5; pure continuum scaling would give -2.6e-6): the direction survives refinement, so it is not a lattice-only instability at this h pair; the fresh Lanczos at h 0.5 and both d0.3 probes did not converge (reported, unresolved). The escape END direction is uphill from the strand (Rayleigh +2.6e-5 at d0.03): the escape is a curved path, not the linear mode
verdict_table.audited: a saddle, amplified residue; lattice artifact
verdict_table.verdict: CONFIRMED saddle; QUALIFIED on lattice-vs-continuum (the direction survives x2 refinement)

verdict_table.claim: F the label STRAND_0258_UNRESOLVED follows from the rule; the rule
verdict_table.own: the label follows (delta 0.03 and 0.01 rows FALLING at h <= 1). The rule inverts the evidence: it passes the small-delta rows because their gate sits at the absolute floor (gate_scaled 0.05 to 1.3 against 7e-6 to 6e-5 at delta 0.03), rows that are 0.7 to 1.5 percent above their converged twins, and fails the converged rows. The FALLING rows are the smooth profile's lattice discretization below the continuum bound (ratios / BPS-seed lattice factor = [1.0017, 1.0009, 1.0007, 1.0011]) plus a decelerating tail, not a slide into the artifact (the plain continuation keeps central / sym at 0.987; the slot-preconditioned descent from the same field does slide, 0.8513 to 0.8083 T_bps in 1500 iterations with the roughness rising, the block-sector saddle). On the numbers the CONFIRMED condition holds at every delta: h^2 extrapolations 1.0002 (0.03), 1.0007 (0.01), 1.0006 (0.001 by the converged twins)
verdict_table.verdict: CONFIRMED (label follows) / QUALIFIED (the rule is the wrong instrument; the extrapolated ratio is 1.000 +- 0.001 at every delta)
